Overview

São Paulo is a city in SP with a population of 12,396,372. Latin America’s largest city and financial powerhouse, a cultural melting pot with world-class dining, arts, and a non-stop urban energy. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
